reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Hyalu-Cica Blue Serum 50mL
reviews.text: Si tienes la piel mixta o grasa hazte un favor y compralo, es lo mejor del mundo, tiene textura en gel, se siente hidratante al instante que te lo pones, se absorbe rapidamente y deja un efecto toque seco sin que la piel se sienta tirante, lo mejor es que ademas de acido hialuronico contiene niacinamida por lo que ayuda un poco para evitar manchas y por la centella asiatica no es irritante
reviews.zh: 如果你係混合性或者油性肌，幫自己一個忙去買佢啦，佢係全世界最好用嘅嘢。佢係 gel 狀質地，一搽上面即刻感覺到保濕，吸收得好快，仲有種乾爽觸感但又唔會令到皮膚覺得繃緊。最正係除咗透明質酸之外，仲有 niacinamide，所以對減少色斑有少少幫助，加上有积雪草，所以唔會刺激。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Hyalu-Cica Blue Serum 50mL
reviews.text: The SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Cream is a true skin savior! Its lightweight, soothing texture absorbs quickly and leaves my skin calm, hydrated, and soft. The centella extract is excellent for reducing redness, irritation, and sensitivity, making it perfect for daily use. My skin feels balanced, comfortable, and healthy all day, even when stressed or reactive. It layers beautifully under other products and provides long-lasting hydration without heaviness. After consistent use, my skin looks more resilient, smooth, and radiant. A must-have for anyone looking to calm and repair their skin
reviews.zh: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Cream 真係皮膚嘅救星！佢質地輕盈舒緩，吸收得好快，令到我塊面感覺平靜、保濕、柔軟。积雪草萃取可以有效減少泛紅、刺激同敏感，適合日常使用。我塊面成日都感覺平衡、舒服、健康，就算係狀態唔好或者容易反應嘅時候都係。佢可以好靚咁疊喺其他產品下面，提供持久保濕但又唔會覺得厚重。持續使用之後，皮膚望落更加有韌性、更加平滑、更加有光澤。任何人想舒緩和修護皮膚嘅話，呢支都係必備之選。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Hyalu-Cica Blue Serum 50mL
reviews.text: This is my first time trying this serum on my oily skin. Let me tell ya, it's good for oily skin! It's gel type, smells good, idk how to describe the scent but slightly floral spa-like scent (hope that helps). The scent didn't cause an irritation my skin. Yes, it helped with my dry patches on my skin, it has a slight cooling sensation to it (or it's just me) it absorbs quickly and it feels refreshing after applying.
reviews.zh: 呢支精華係我第一次搽喺我嘅油性皮膚上面。同你講啦，佢真係好啱油性肌！佢係 gel 狀，味道好聞，我唔識點形容個味道，似係少少花香 spa 嘅感覺（希望幫到你）。個味道冇令到我皮膚敏感。佢真係幫到我皮膚上面嗰啲乾燥嘅位置，搽上去有少少涼浸浸嘅感覺（又可能只係我感覺），而且吸收得好快，搽完之後感覺好清爽。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Hyalu-Cica Blue Serum 50mL
reviews.text: De mis sueros de AH favoritos, sientes la hidratación y me encanta que no se absorbe como otros que de tan rápido a los segundos sientes que no te aplicaste nada. Aquí si te queda la piel jugosita, no me da ninguna reacción ni activa mi rosacea.
reviews.zh: 我最鍾意嘅透明質酸精華之一，用完會feel 到保濕感。我好鍾意佢唔似其他精華咁快就吸收晒，搞到你幾秒之後覺得自己好似冇搽過咁。呢款用完皮膚真係會keep 住水潤，又唔會引起任何反應，亦唔會觸發我嘅玫瑰痤瘡。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Hyalu-Cica Blue Serum 50mL
reviews.text: I love love love this product. It is so soothing and hydrating for my skin. It really calms redness, and smells lovely without a heavy or irritating fragrance. It also absorbs very fast, and doesn’t leave me with an annoying film feeling on my skin.
reviews.zh: 我超超超鍾意呢個產品。對我嘅皮膚嚟講超級舒緩又保濕。佢真係可以減退泛紅，氣味又好聞，冇乜厚重或者刺激嘅香料。而且吸收得好快，唔會令我皮膚有種煩人嘅薄膜感。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Hyalu-Cica Blue Serum 50mL
reviews.text: I didn’t feel like this did much for my skin. I didnt think it was any more hydrating or calming than the plain centella asiatica serum. It is cooling and does reduce some redness I think.
reviews.zh: 我覺得呢款對我嘅皮膚冇咩明顯效果。比起普通嘅積雪草精華，我唔覺得佢更加保濕或者舒緩。佢有清涼感，我覺得都可以稍為減退泛紅。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Hyalu-Cica Blue Serum 50mL
reviews.text: The best hyaluronic acid serum I have ever tried. It doesn't leave my skin feeling tight like other serums and actually feels plumping and moisturizing. I also have combination skin and other hyaluronic acid serums make my skin very oily this one does not.
reviews.zh: 係我用過最好嘅透明質酸精華。佢唔似其他精華咁令我皮膚有繃緊感，反而真係有種飽滿同保濕嘅感覺。我係混合性肌膚，其他透明質酸精華會令我塊面好油，呢款就唔會。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Hyalu-Cica Blue Serum 50mL
reviews.text: I much prefer this serum to the torriden hyaluronic acid serum. I use this in the morning and it cools my skin nicely while giving an inner plumpness that makes it feel moisturized. It easily layers on top other products and under moisturizer and sunscreen. I have oily combination skin and it's definitely lightweight enough to use daily. Love this!!
reviews.zh: 比起 Torriden 嘅透明質酸精華，我更加鍾意呢款。我朝早用佢，可以好好降溫皮膚，仲會由內到外有種飽滿感，感覺好保濕。佢好容易疊加喺其他產品之上，亦可以搽喺保濕霜同防曬之前。我係油性混合肌，呢款質地夠輕身，可以日日用。好鍾意呢款！！
